text: Requirements own invariant WHAT; accepted design owns structural HOW, interfaces, topology, carriers, file placement and delivery mechanisms; code realises those decisions. Requirements plus accepted design govern implementation, not implementation precedent. Technology choice belongs to design unless already constitutionally constrained.

Every substantive change enters intake triage, regardless of its label. Record intent, affected Product and scope, lawful class, re-entry point and triage time, downstream surfaces and evidence requiring re-evaluation, and release-scope impact. Diagnose realisation defect, governing insufficiency, inaccurate prediction or insufficient observation from evidence; a diagnosis grants no repair effects.

A realization_refactor is local code, configuration or attribute change with no intended constitutional or structural change: it re-enters only the realised surface and must prove no upstream drift. A design_reframe changes realisation structure while intent and requirement truth remain stable and re-enters Design, then Code and Evidence. Smaller changes explicitly assert unchanged upstream constitution. A class label is not a successful no-drift evaluation.

Computed classification keeps reproducible facts/rule application (C), residual semantic/materiality judgment (J) and owner-reserved ruling (O) distinct. Bind producer/procedure, exact inputs, scope, source/reproduction routes, unknowns and invalidators. Traverse declared authority, ownership, dependency and projection relations including root/grant changes even with equal public bytes; retain the unresolved frontier. Enumerate the complete relevant public member universe and exact typed/byte deltas; joins to current accepted design distinguish covered, missing, stale, ambiguous and outside-scope. Apply only rules with sufficient premises; a missing candidate, edge, projection or evidence does not prove unchanged meaning.

Variation only in entity/projection/transition/policy/subordinate payload normally uses typed parameters or closed variants of one atomic family. Each discovered functionality row is admitted atomic derivation, declared higher-order composition, owned deferment with re-entry, Product exclusion or named gap. Higher-order behaviour declares composition/effect algebra and applicable identity, closure, associativity, cardinality, effect and authority laws. No private helper/loop/adapter/endpoint may become an undeclared constructor.

Handle every material failure, unknown, refusal and unavailable capability with a known lawful next move under the actual contract; this is not a proof of external termination. Hard stops remain violated invariant, missing authority/capability, undeclared irreversible effect or an explicit approval gate regardless of risk appetite. Diagnose whether to repair implementation, re-enter insufficient law, revise an inaccurate prediction or obtain missing observation. Difficulty, a slow provider or test count alone does not authorize new scope or governing change.

Apply source terms in their declared bounded context and exact basis. Resolve the nearest explicit scope, admitted local/imported definitions and owner-authorized overrides; exactly one concept must remain. Same names, directory proximity, glossary matches, data shapes or familiar examples do not supply a definition or authority. Zero or multiple material meanings fail closed and name the missing relation/owner. A method cut's integrity and availability do not automatically adopt a profile or activate a configuration; Product authority owns its exact Project Reference-Frame Basis and selected optional refinements.

Optional profile law is selected by actual adopted scope, not language, pure/local status or available documents. DESIGN_MODULE governs module realization; adopted ODD additionally owns graph-native operative carriers and traversal authority; a realized UX surface additionally needs its applicable UX law, default-trigger/exemption determination and actual product carrier. ODD, TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE and WORLD_MODEL are distinct optional profiles: ODD does not imply the latter two, and world-model/metaphysical framing is not a prerequisite to engineering Ontology. If task-specific adopted law outside this exact method-constraint closure materially decides the task, acquire it through the named Product authority packet before that action; this index does not claim to replace it.

Under adopted ODD, preserve typed Asset boundaries and named published GraphFunctions/compositions as the operative constructive carriers. Declare inputs/outputs, intent, public/helper role, outer/inner vector/refinement relations and produced/consumed AssetSurface contracts. Design the typed outcome traversal and GTL/ABG carrier before its minimal adapters. Local scripts, services, nested calls and packaging are implementations, not rival semantic or graph authority. Public carriers structurally compare to admitted source; missing, stale or same-name divergent truth fails closed unless an explicit migration makes the divergence lawful.

Preserve one ABG owner for traversal consequence: runtime truth/event replay, graph-call lifecycle, actor/process supervision, continuation, retry/re-entry and step selection. Product subsystems perform bounded admitted work and publish/return evidence; do not add hidden controllers, local retry loops, direct runtime append or plugin continuation. A change to a materially deciding runtime/start/iterate/transport/actor/plugin/event/closure/retry surface triggers the five-surface execution-authority audit (traversal, actor/process, retry/continuation, runtime events, closure fold), using actual code/static call-path evidence. Exactly one consumer-bound ABG authority applies to each affected traversal unless a ratified nonoverlapping design says otherwise.

Keep synthesize_model, eval_gap, evaluate_next and evaluate_action as four distinct authority functions. Model synthesis uses admitted intent lineage/prior model/product truth without observing worksite or selecting/invoking/closing work. eval_gap only observes runtime/worksite truth against the model. evaluate_next ranks published lawful actions against fresh gap, exact target binding, catalogue and policy; it neither admits intent nor closes prior work. evaluate_action folds admitted action evidence into ledger/closure, never selects the next graph action. Shared implementation libraries do not merge these authorities; a helper refactor must preserve this separation.

Each constructive action binds its exact selected Product outcome, any admitted prerequisite/experiment, current gap, target assets, required roles, evidence and lawful outcomes before invocation. Models, pressure, assurance or projections cannot author/enlarge that external outcome. Work selection stops at accepted outcome, discharged prerequisite, resolved experiment, another admitted terminal condition, or exhausted/rejected/withdrawn/superseded/repriced/falsified basis. Reprice requests owning re-entry and cannot choose a successor outcome or fallback action. An unpublished desired action produces typed no-action, not a broad executive graph or local script substitute.

Workspace and governed ledger are distinct: mutable workspace observations are not admitted truth. Closure-relevant F_P work, including evaluator proposals, enters immutable ledger/event lineage before it affects closure or routing. Evaluators judge an exact admitted ledger snapshot and may attend only to evidence reachable through the declared lineage, predecessor refs, target binding, policy and event cursor. Corrections append/supersede, never rewrite governed history. F_P may inspect/reason/draft/propose within the bounded action; it cannot close an edge, emit runtime events, mutate ledgers or decide re-entry. Admission retains its own deterministic criteria and grant; an F_D claim additionally needs its separately established total-domain contract.

Closure is an admitted-evidence fold into EdgeFulfillmentLedger and EdgeClosureDecision, not raw file presence, worker prose, process success or CLI output. The closed decision vocabulary is close, yield, retry, repair, re-enter, reprice, block, each with exact basis/reason refs and its predicate-specific core result: close satisfied; yield indeterminate; defeated retry/implementation repair falsified; undecided retry/proof repair indeterminate; undeclared re-entry/block or reprice out_of_frame; unsupporting-basis re-entry/block invalid_basis (both causes retain both and take basis). Edge closure, candidate availability and acceptance answer distinct predicates; repair is not local_repair and re-enter is not re_enter. No result may count for another predicate.

evaluate_next is total over initial selection and explicit post-yield/close/retry/repair/re-entry/reprice/block bases. Yield retains the same lawful edge, admitted progress/waiting and replay-visible resume basis without failure classification. After retry/repair/re-entry/block, prefer a higher-priority lawful action, else the still-lawful graph edge, else typed no-action/re-entry under exact authority. Unresolved post_reprice returns no_action(undeclared), never a replacement action. A no-action binds its own selection predicate (undeclared maps out_of_frame, unsupported basis invalid_basis); graph completion's empty selection is only invocational data. Liveness/timeout alone neither falsifies semantics nor closes the edge. Retry/repair/re-entry execution follows published actions selected from admitted closure truth.

Public query/gaps views are read-only projections of gap, closure and next-action results, never paths to event append, work invocation, intent admission, evaluation side effects or local traversal selection. Replay must reproduce each closure/next decision from event log, exact execution basis, admitted intent/model publication, outcome/bounded basis, gap/target binding, action catalogue, evidence, ledger, prior decision, next-action basis and policy. Each carrier carries reachable causal predecessor refs, not external joins reconstructed from names. Published refinement obeys this loop recursively; opaque local computation may compute one bounded action but cannot become a hidden graph controller. Preserve unchanged accepted relations without whole-family reproving; affected controlling axioms override weaker local checklists and create no new Product work.

A graph-bound function declares cumulative typed requires/provides/carries, preserving the outer vector contract through any published refinement; it consumes accumulated admitted environment, not merely the last output. Coarse/inner closure folds must agree. Missing current required proof keeps closure open unless lawful deferment/repricing supplies its exact disposition. Domain semantics remain Product-owned above shared carriers. Refactoring a shared carrier cannot re-author domain meaning, use graph closure as release acceptance or silently erase predecessor evidence requirements.

ODD conformance preserves an end-to-end manual/agentic F_P walkthrough over the minimal exact authority packet and a separate admission gate for produced artifacts. General-method projections may orient source precedence/re-entry/traceability, but Product-specific behavior comes from the current Product packet. Bad reasoning/stale-memory use is agent error; a method defect requires a competent correctly configured actor blocked by actual source ambiguity/missing step/contradiction. A flaky live provider does not prove constitutional process failure. Walkthrough/admission evidence is not ratification. Where authority-path validity is claimed, remove/invalidate the actual authority input on the supported path and prove refusal before effects with no fallback, distinguishing source, package, installed and runtime absence.

Product-truth-changing UX messages bind one admitted Product carrier/action path: AssetSurface, published GraphFunction/composition, admitted workorder/job/runtime command, ABG boundary or the exact equivalent typed design contract. No carrier means blocked dependent construction and owning re-entry, not local UI invention. State derives from the authoritative shared contract; Product messages map one-to-one to its action registry or a documented meaning-preserving projection; writes follow that path and selection follows its Context contract. UI work context carries the deciding UX law and names the actual carrier/path when Product truth changes; this method index does not invent those Product-specific coordinates.

When reviewing code under this profile, check every required relation applicable to the exact claim; for functional-bias/pure-transform/immutable-carrier/single-truth/low-coupling claims, explicitly apply the functional realization checks. Domain, sequence and state views must agree: sequence participants exist in the domain model, messages bind declared transforms/constructors/interpreter acts/effect boundaries, and transitions derive admitted carrier/event/projection truth rather than controller memory. The cross-view matrix evaluates applicable Product, graph, language, runtime, handler and module laws as pass, fail or reasoned not_applicable. A relied-on semantic_not_realized constructor blocks promotion/closure; an accepted verdict and proportionate sequencing are required at their actual design/promotion boundary, with unchanged valid evidence reusable. Negative proof must show imperative bypass, open-payload bypass and effect-edge truth erasure fail closed. If a deterministic module appears to own next work, target movement, traversal closure or graph-function identity, its boundary should be repriced against graph-execution law before design-method closure; this is not inferred graph adoption from purity. An unanswered required relation withholds its dependent conformance claim and names deciding evidence/owner; missing authority or observation alone does not diagnose excessive coupling without evidence that meaning lives in orchestration or outside declared carriers/transforms.
